description: Fix image-gen.ts to handle gpt-image-2 base64 response format (b64_json) by uploading the decoded image to R2 storage and returning its presigned URL
steps: In apps/web/src/lib/assets/image-gen.ts, update the generateImage function to accept a userId parameter (needed for building storage keys)
Update the OpenAI direct path to include response_format: 'b64_json' in the request body when calling gpt-image-2 (this model returns b64_json, not URLs)

After receiving the response, check for BOTH data[0].url AND data[0].b64_json. If b64_json is present, decode the base64 string to a Buffer, upload it to R2 using presignUpload (following the pattern in product-images.ts and script-to-audio.ts), then return the presigned download URL
The storage key pattern should be: `generated-images/<userId>/<timestamp>.png`
Update the ImageGenRequest interface to include an optional userId field
Update the call site in orchestrate.ts gatherAssets function to pass userId to generateImage

Update apps/web/src/lib/assets/image-gen.test.ts to add tests for the b64_json response path: (a) successfully decodes and returns a storage URL when b64_json is present, (b) handles both url and b64_json fields (url takes priority for backward compat with dall-e-3)
Ensure all existing tests still pass by updating any affected assertions
acceptance_criteria: generateImage handles gpt-image-2 responses where data[0].b64_json contains base64 PNG data
The base64 data is decoded and uploaded to R2 storage via presignUpload/PUT
A presigned download URL is returned instead of null
The function still works with dall-e-3 URL responses (backward compatible)
The function still returns null gracefully on errors (no throwing)
New unit tests cover the b64_json path
findings: All 153 tests pass. The presignUpload/presignDownload mocks in the test file use vi.mock at module level to avoid loading the real crypto-based storage module. The orchestrate.test.ts already had generateImage mocked so it was unaffected by the signature change. Review fixes applied: added crypto.randomUUID() suffix to storage keys to prevent Date.now() collisions, and wrapped generatePlaceholderImage in try/catch in gatherAssets so storage outages during fallback do not crash the pipeline.
